description: This file defines the Vault class for managing encrypted vaults, including creation, locking, unlocking, password management, and note encryption/decryption within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Class for managing encrypted vaults, handling password operations, note encryption/decryption, and vault state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new vault with the specified password, encrypting the vault key.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the vault, clearing the password and publishing a lock event.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the vault with the provided password after verifying the vault key.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the vault password, re-encrypting related notes.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all notes from the vault.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the vault and optionally all locked notes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Locks (adds) a note to the vault.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes (unlocks) a note from the vault permanently.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note in the vault, encrypting its content.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if the vault exists and is valid.

methods.name: getVaultPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the current vault password, throws if vault is not available or locked.

methods.name: unlockNote
methods.description: Unlocks (decrypts) a note, optionally for permanent access.
